text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear position in opening and closing","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states a defensible stance up front and returns to it at the end, making its overall argument easy to follow."},{"evidence":"Three body paragraphs on accidents, preference, and money","quality":"organization","description":"The essay develops distinct reasons in separate paragraphs, giving the argument a more coherent structure."},{"evidence":"“as said in the article” and laws/liability details","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay uses specific information from the source article to back up its claims rather than relying mainly on unsupported opinion."},{"evidence":"Questions about insurance, ownership, and replacement costs","quality":"development","description":"The essay expands each point with explanation and implications, so the reasons feel more fully worked out."},{"evidence":"Fewer repeated wording problems than B","quality":"sentence control","description":"Although imperfect, the writing is generally more controlled and readable than the other essay's run-on, repetitive phrasing."}]}
